title: User Roles: Removing or Changing User Access
summary: This document explains how to change or remove a user’s access in user management by selecting the user, choosing “Change role” or “Remove access,” and entering a brief reason for the audit trail. It also covers the 48-hour security delay with admin notifications (and the option to cancel during the notification window), the 15 role-assignment limit, and required post-change verification steps.
